{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "esol_size_ring_branch_transfer",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "short_solute_bonus",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_short"},
          "weight": 0.5,
          "rationale": "Source ESOL prior gives smiles_short +6.89; small solutes need little cavity work to solvate."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "mid_length_penalty",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_mid"},
          "weight": -0.45,
          "rationale": "Source prior for smiles_mid is -6.61; extra nonpolar surface raises cavity-formation cost."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "acyclic_scaffold_bonus",
          "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_none"},
          "weight": 0.4,
          "rationale": "Ring role carried the highest transfer weight (0.76); acyclic solutes lack rigid hydrophobic ring surface."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "unbranched_chain_bonus",
          "conditions": {"branch_bin": "branch_none"},
          "weight": 0.2,
          "rationale": "Rotatable-bond role maps to branching (weight 0.76); low branching means less buried nonpolar volume."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.3,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.32,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.1,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.01,
      "confidence": 0.4,
      "hypothesis": "Transfers signed ESOL length priors and the high-weight ring and branch roles, assuming solubility and hydration share size-driven cavity mechanisms. Fails if hydration is governed by polar hydrogen bonding rather than solute size."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "polarity_dominant_hydration_counter",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "heteroatom_rich_hydrogen_bonding",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": 0.7,
          "rationale": "Dense N/O centers form strong water hydrogen bonds, the dominant favorable term in hydration free energy."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "moderate_polarity_bonus",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_mid"},
          "weight": 0.35,
          "rationale": "Moderate heteroatom content still supplies polar solvation while covering 91 candidates for surrogate stability."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "pure_hydrocarbon_penalty",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_none", "halogen_bin": "halogen_none"},
          "weight": -0.6,
          "rationale": "Unsubstituted hydrocarbons offer no hydrogen-bond partners and pay full hydrophobic cavity cost."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "heavy_halogen_penalty",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_high"},
          "weight": -0.35,
          "rationale": "Extensive halogenation adds nonpolar, weakly hydrogen-bonding surface despite higher polarizability."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.2,
      "prior_scale": 0.4,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.34,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.1,
      "ucb_weight": 0.55,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.2,
      "gp_beta_end": 0.9,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.55,
      "hypothesis": "Downweights the low-confidence ESOL length role (0.22) and asserts heteroatom polarity drives hydration. Fails if the score rewards compact nonpolar solutes or if polar bins are too sparse to inform the surrogate."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "polarity_dominant_hydration_counter",
  "lesson": "Source role confidences are low (0.16-0.41) and length is the weakest role, so a mechanistic polarity hypothesis with graded heteroatom coverage and fast semantic decay is safer than literal size transfer.",
  "revision_summary": "Corrected all conditions to the required field-to-value object form. Kept the source-grounded transfer with signed length priors and the highest-weight ring and branch roles. Strengthened the counter-hypothesis by replacing the near-constant short-length reversal with a hetero_mid coverage rule and a mechanistic hydrocarbon interaction (hetero_none plus halogen_none), improving surrogate support beyond the sparse hetero_high bin. Both skills decay semantic mass toward the target-only anchor; the polarity skill is frozen for deployment."
}
